final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---- bias: sink IREF with diode-connected nfet ----
MB   ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=4 L=1
* ---- tail current source ----
MT   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=8 L=1
* ---- input pair (vinp side drives high-Z node x) ----
M1   x     vinp  tail vss nfet W=4 L=0.5
M2   d     vinn  tail vss nfet W=4 L=0.5
* ---- PMOS mirror load (diode on vinn side) ----
M3   d     d     vdd  vdd pfet W=4 L=1
M4   x     d     vdd  vdd pfet W=4 L=1
* ---- second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS sink ----
M6   vout  x     vdd  vdd pfet W=24 L=1
M7   vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=24 L=1
* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ----
Rz   x     cz    2000
Cc   cz    vout  1.5e-12
.ends dut
